# Cerence AI’s Mobile Work Agent Selected as Automotive Cybersecurity Innovation of the Year in 2026 AutoTech Breakthrough Awards


October 15, 2026 9:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://investors.cerence.com/_assets/_3cc9ec31e740d9b8c0a5f385caed8706/cerence/news/2026-10-15_Cerence_AI_s_Mobile_Work_Agent_Selected_as_384.pdf)


**Summary and Key Points:**


- Cerence AI’s Mobile Work Agent was named "Automotive Cybersecurity Innovation of the Year" by AutoTech Breakthrough for bringing secure, voice-first access to Microsoft 365 into the vehicle.
- The production-ready solution enables drivers and passengers to securely manage emails, meetings, notes, and tasks through natural conversation, helping users stay productive on the move without relying on smartphones or compromising safety.
- Developed with Microsoft, Mobile Work Agent transforms the vehicle into a trusted enterprise device using Microsoft security products such as Entra ID, Intune, and Purview, as well as Agentic Zero Trust and defense in depth security principles, to extend workplace security and governance into the car.


BURLINGTON, Mass., Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Cerence Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Gq4dTalYYjl7JlaB2MY9OBz5tmAe9rY2bBuMVNehCP9ZmNchIzIe06OFfOq5T12_mjI4XX481zDeco5mv4rfMw==) (NASDAQ: CRNC) (“Cerence AI”), a global leader pioneering conversational AI-powered user experiences, today announced that its[Mobile Work Agent](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=QJdFX67DmvLNGnZJfyqGwPraj9fxxLxYlARB-yRjyzJ0IZ88BQREXYTp_LObWig3Bs74jBqsB7HqRW-qZMfpTwYgH6jPKxHDM8-XMaPQWhuyxMhoDxmBi-i1AFsdRLLWQnuYpoZ6SE6uxHo7Aw0kXA==) has been named "Automotive Cybersecurity Innovation of the Year" in the seventh annual AutoTech Breakthrough Awards program.[AutoTech Breakthrough](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=UWc2ploLb0nqGYOjmH8SuglrKUpqQ3cBhtl26hQqmF6j3M-CocXtzqf1KpT6AltDGitCbH6nhOrri3DBOrAEycIzCY-sbT0NX-xs5zoB1J7-M3PXdcUYRKZSk54Ct_mN) is a leading market intelligence organization that recognizes the top companies, technologies, and products in the global automotive and transportation technology markets.


Despite the amount of time professionals spend on the road, the vehicle has remained largely disconnected from the workplace tools that they rely on every day. Developed in collaboration with Microsoft, Mobile Work Agent brings enterprise-secure, voice-first access to Microsoft 365 into the vehicle, enabling drivers and passengers to manage emails, meetings, notes, and tasks through natural conversation while keeping their focus on the road. Mobile Work Agent is production-ready and expected to debut in vehicles later this year with a global, premium automaker.


As enterprises extend AI-powered experiences across new devices and environments, security and governance remain critical considerations. Mobile Work Agent gives the vehicle trusted device status in the eyes of corporate IT, securely connecting vehicles with workplace systems while maintaining the policies, controls, and protections organizations already rely on, including identity and access management for their AI agents.


Through integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and Microsoft Purview, as well as enterprise identity systems, organizations can extend existing authentication, identity management, device compliance, and security policies into the vehicle. Built on Agentic Zero Trust and defense in depth principles, Mobile Work Agent helps ensure access to corporate data is governed by the same security frameworks employees already use across laptops and mobile devices. It also adheres to multiple industry standards including the EU WP.29, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), EU AI ACT, ISO-21434, and TISAX, and is compliant with frameworks like NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, and OWASP's Top 10.


Rather than relying on smartphones or fragmented in-car workflows, users can securely access the information they need through a seamless voice-first experience designed specifically for driving. With Mobile Work Agent, users stay informed and productive without navigating apps, switching interfaces, or reaching for a phone. By combining Microsoft 365 with real-time vehicle context, Mobile Work Agent can also proactively surface relevant information based on a user's workday, schedule, and destination.


"Both enterprises and drivers have long wanted a secure, practical way to access workplace tools while on the move," said Christian Mentz, Chief Revenue Officer at Cerence AI. "With Mobile Work Agent, we have helped define a new category of in-vehicle experiences, turning the car into a trusted device with full access to Microsoft 365. By combining conversational AI and deep vehicle integration with security and governance designed around globally recognized standards and frameworks, we’re helping set a new benchmark for secure productivity in the vehicle. We're honored that AutoTech Breakthrough has recognized that innovation."


The annual AutoTech Breakthrough Awards recognize the innovators transforming the global automotive and mobility landscape with breakthrough technology. The program conducts a comprehensive analysis of the companies redefining how vehicles are designed, manufactured, driven, and maintained.


“Cerence AI is enabling working professionals to manage their days while on the move. More people are taking a flexible approach to work, getting things done when and where it makes sense for them. From emails to meetings, the car has never been a safe or secure place to get work done. It isn’t connected to enterprise systems, it isn’t secure and trying to work from a phone while driving introduces safety risks,” said Bryan Vaughn, Managing Director, AutoTech Breakthrough. “Mobile Work Agent helps drivers stay productive on the move without compromising company security or their safety. By combining automotive-grade AI with enterprise trust, Cerence AI is transforming the car into a practical, trusted place to get work done, enabling smarter, safer productivity. We’re awarding Cerence AI with ‘Automotive Cybersecurity Innovation of The Year.’”

**About Cerence Inc.**
Cerence Inc. (NASDAQ: CRNC) is a global industry leader in creating intuitive, seamless, AI-powered experiences across automotive and transportation. Leveraging decades of innovation and expertise in voice, generative AI, and large language models, Cerence powers integrated experiences that create safer, more connected, and more enjoyable journeys for drivers and passengers alike. With more than 525 million cars shipped with Cerence technology, the company partners with leading automakers, transportation OEMs, and technology companies to advance the next generation of user experiences. Cerence is headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, with operations globally and a worldwide team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of AI innovation. For more information, visit[www.cerence.ai](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Lk37BRjcd8Hd9F6YEpRJ0K83O1ur7WfZo0P6C8KPxcgShU0tOgQcXDF6QT-5bHHnuIwqpI80tjuFUCtxypoWtg==) .
